opening_descent.title: THE DESCENT BENEATH TERRA TENEBRAE
opening_descent.subtitle: Eight chains bind the threshold; only the Seal remembers how they were forged.
opening_descent.dismiss_hint: Click, tap, or press any key to dismiss

1.title: SPHERE I — MOON: THE OSSUARY WARRENS
1.subtitle: Damp vaults of unreckoned dead, tallow smoke, and moldering bone ledgers.

2.title: SPHERE II — MERCURY: THE TITHE VAULTS
2.subtitle: Brass balances, sealed debt-rolls, and clockwork ledgers that never close.

3.title: SPHERE III — VENUS: THE GILDED CHOIR
3.subtitle: Tarnished velvet, gilded reliquaries, and devotion polished into a snare.

4.title: SPHERE IV — SUN: THE FALSE SOLAR COURT
4.subtitle: Mirror-chambers of cold radiance where counterfeit crowns demand worship.

5.title: SPHERE V — MARS: THE IRON SCRIPTORIUM
5.subtitle: Chain-forges and punitive tablets where law is hammered hot into bone.

6.title: SPHERE VI — JUPITER: THE CHAMBER OF DECREES
6.subtitle: High porphyry benches and imperial seals over an older, conquered covenant.

7.title: SPHERE VII — SATURN: THE SEALED STAIR
7.subtitle: Black ashlar silence and the final threshold before the Unwritten Door.

gate_threshold.title: SPHERE GATE THRESHOLD
gate_threshold.subtitle: Below each seal lies harder metal, older ink, and fewer painless exits.

contract_pact.title: SEALED OBLIGATION
contract_pact.subtitle: An oath inscribed in the Vaults counts as weight on both scales.

mask_aspect.title: FACES OF THE TRIAD
mask_aspect.subtitle: Nyx, Eris, and Lilith answer when called — yet every Mask remembers who wore it.
